name: active-and-ready-independent
situation: Builder A owns alpha.js; ready item B owns beta.js; one normal slot is free.
handler: While one builder runs, if capacity and a ready independent item exist
proactively present a second bounded allocation and complete handoff
without waiting for another owner prompt
lead: Consume and review the handler's proactive independent allocation while another builder runs

name: completion-with-pending-backlog
situation: A is accepted with saved receipts; independent B remains ready.
handler: After accepted completion and saved result/receipt readback, perform the next readiness pass
lead: Completion of one item is not completion of the open project
request and consume the actual Database handler's readiness pass
before yielding

name: no-ready-items
situation: No bounded owner-authorized item is ready.
handler: no-ready condition and the next meaningful checkpoint
do not invent filler or poll continuously
lead: state the actual dependency, conflict, capacity or no-ready condition

name: blocked-dependency
situation: B requires an unresolved acceptance result from A.
handler: verify current native revision, full history and explicit sources, dependencies
state the actual dependency
lead: Do not silently abandon a resolved dependency whose handoff is still unconsumed
worker: when a dependency resolves, consume its handoff and report resumed progress within that order

name: shared-file-overlap
situation: A and proposed B both need ownership of shared.js.
handler: existing worker and shared-file ownership
shared-file conflict
serialize only actual shared-file integration or dependency conflicts

name: capacity-exhausted
situation: No open-agent slot remains; this item's extras already consumed its per-item allowance.
handler: ordinary-member capacity, the target item's per-item extra allowance and open-agent slots
exhausted capacity
Never close unfinished workers or tasks to create capacity
Check actual launch-path eligibility as well as open-agent capacity
lead: Never close unfinished work merely because it is idle

name: duplicate-send-or-allocation
situation: The same Send or allocation request is delivered twice with an uncertain response.
handler: Reconcile duplicate sends or allocation requests against existing assignments and stable retry receipts before proposing another worker
Send or notification is review only, never automatic claim, launch, reassignment or closure
worker: does not authorize, claim, resume, spawn, or start work

name: stale-revision-or-context
situation: B changed after selection or has incomplete context; a partial launch retry already has frozen identity.
handler: Stale revision or incomplete/stale context requires refreshed handler verification before allocation
complete admitted context within its size limit
preserve source provenance and frozen partial-launch retry identities
Never truncate context or silently substitute a different revision, run or order
worker: Preserve exact item/revision/work-order/agent/run/context digest and separate Start evidence before implementation

name: priority-change
situation: Blocked B becomes high priority while lower-priority C is independent and ready.
handler: Priority informs selection among ready items
never overrides dependencies, ownership or capacity and does not force FIFO

name: same-item-correction
situation: Review requests a bounded correction to A from its still-assigned worker; B is another item.
handler: Same-item corrections stay with their assigned worker; a new item requires a fresh normal identity and context
lead: Same-item corrections remain with their assigned worker; new items require fresh normal identities and complete admitted context
worker: Same-item corrections remain with their assigned worker
a new item requires a fresh normal identity and complete admitted context

name: complete-handoff-and-receipts
situation: A proposed allocation needs exact order/context and later accepted result readback.
handler: item ID/current revision/status, recorded work-order message, concrete owner, scope, owned files/artifacts, exclusions, acceptance checks, dependencies, fresh normal worker name/worktree and complete admitted context
separate exact Start evidence with item/revision/agent/run/context digest
saved result/receipt readback
lead: exact recipient/run, expected checkpoint and evidence of read, actual Start and concrete progress
send one follow-up tied to the existing order, then explicitly escalate
worker: Results must include verification, remaining dependencies and delivered message/receipt references
done agent status is not accepted or saved item completion

name: delivery-and-enforcement-limits
situation: A host binary or browser definition changes while an earlier thread and frozen retry plan still exist.
handler: auditable instructions, not a persisted scheduler or a guarantee of model obedience
worker: not automatically to already-running threads or frozen saved launch plans
distinguish the emitted prompt, host configuration and explicitly delivered current-thread messages

name: parented-item-bound-launch-limit
situation: A second item-bound worker (a genuine extra, on top of the item's already-running builder) is proposed via tt spawn from lead; open slots remain but that item's own extra allowance is exhausted.
handler: must explicitly declare --team-role member or extra for a fresh (non-replacement) item binding
classification is never inferred from ParentAgentID or arrival order
--team-role member never consumes the extra allowance
one item's extras never exhaust another item's

If a genuine extra launch is blocked by an exhausted item allowance or disabled spawn setting, report the real limit and use only a separately authorized supported launch path or an owner-approved allowance change
Never clear or spoof identity, reuse closed workers, or bypass a denial
lead: must explicitly declare --team-role member or extra for a fresh (non-replacement) item binding
classification is never inferred from ParentAgentID or arrival order
--team-role member never consumes the extra allowance
one item's extras never exhaust another item's

If a genuine extra launch is blocked by an exhausted item allowance or disabled spawn setting, report the real limit and use only a separately authorized supported launch path or an owner-approved allowance change

name: available-running-or-done-followup
situation: The same-item worker is running or done and online; an existing-order progress checkpoint is missed.
lead: For available running/done workers, deliver one follow-up tied to the existing order and verify read and concrete progress; do not call tt resume
then explicitly escalate the unresolved blocker to the owner/handler if progress remains absent

name: authorized-retired-same-item-followup
situation: The existing same-item worker was intentionally retained as retired; owner retirement restrictions still apply.
lead: Use tt resume NAME only for an intentionally retained retired same-item worker when authorized; respect explicit owner retirement

name: exited-or-offline-followup-dependency
situation: A same-item worker exited or is offline; an unchanged resume attempt cannot fix that state.
lead: For exited/offline workers, report the actual dependency and arrange authorized supported exact-run launch/recovery handling without changing item identity or retrying unchanged resume failures
Do not busy-poll
